svg.title: The Teletype Model 33
svg.desc: A simple hand-drawn picture. On a stand, a big boxy green teleprinter with a keyboard of round keys and a paper roll lying across the back. The paper coming out says "PAT"; after the T there is a gap, the colon has not arrived yet. Sound marks "clack clack" next to the print head. Beside it a person in a blue T-shirt waits with a mug of tea, and the bubble says "Ten letters a second.". A label "110 baud" points to the machine and "two stop bits" to the gap after the T. No brand on the machine.
